$comment: First-load budgets in KB (1000 bytes) of gzip -9, checked by ui/scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs in CI. baselineKb is origin/main before phase 0 (2026-11-04); the budgets are the phase-0 result plus a little headroom. Raising one is a decision (planning/frontend-unification-plan.md §8), not a fix. Manager raised 630 -> 650 KB on 2026-11-14 by the owner's decision: #1272 measured 630 against a main that did not yet include the UI PRs merged alongside it, and together they reached 641.1 KB. Raised 650 -> 660 KB on 2026-11-16, again by the owner's decision: main sat just under 650 KB, and #1273, #1278, #1365 and #1375 each measured 650.7 to 651.1 KB.
